distinction: one big smooth sloping mass filling an open scene, against small close compact things held near the camera
positive: volcano/valley/alp slopes, tents, yurts, balloons, ski slopes: a single large low peak or dome with a wide empty surround
negative: small bright round or glossy objects seen close up (balls, whistle, oscilloscope trace, small dogs): keeps out near, compact, high-detail things

distinction: a thin jet of bright spray rising from below
positive: fireboat spray, geyser, fountains lit at night, a city with a fountain jet
negative: unread dark ground animals: hyena, tiger cat, gas pump, digital watch

distinction: a lattice of crossing thin lines
positive: chainlink fence, worm fence, ballplayer behind backstop, cage, cougar behind wire
negative: car wheel, washbasin, assault rifle, whiskey jug, analog clock, slow cooker: smooth solids and dials

distinction: vivid small body with thin legs or thin repeated weave pattern, versus dark or grey plain things
positive: indigo bunting, paintbrush weave, bee eater, black grouse, redshank, fly, ladybug, prairie chicken; weak peak 0.6
negative: Norfolk terrier, keyboard, giant schnauzer, cassette player, apron, pop bottles, digital watch: dark grey and cluttered

distinction: long wavy hanging ear or fringe, against upright pointed ear
positive: Welsh springer, Brittany, cocker, English setter, Irish water spaniel, red-breasted merganser, swimsuit pattern
negative: white wolf, timber wolf, husky, Samoyed: upright triangular ears; also arch, minibus, bell tower, tent

distinction: a dark rounded dome or smooth convex blob on a lighter ground (helmet, pot lid, hat, head), versus radial dials
positive: Dutch oven lid, hatchet head, shield, bearskin hat, swimsuit, hare, albatross, sunglass; weak (peak 1.0)
negative: car wheel, wall clock, compass, daisy, barometer, analog clock: radial dials

distinction: a soft bright plume or flame rising from a dark base
positive: candle flame, fountain, geyser, crane, white dogs (Bedlington, borzoi)
negative: glossy glasses, dial faces, stopwatch, sunglasses, short-coated dogs

distinction: A broad dial (on for 97% of photos, mean 3.35) that rises when one smooth, large, low-texture region sits against a calm background (water, bedspread, studio surface) and falls to negative on small, sharp, saturated warm-coloured items on cluttered ground.
positive: Peak photos: quilt on a bed, projector, speedboat and its wake, bird over open water, alligator on a log, shark and dugong under water. Heat maps sit on the smooth surface or the water, not on one object.
negative: Barn, red plunger, cello, baseball, whistle, hamster: compact, warm or red, hard-edged things.

distinction: many thin parallel ribs or keys repeated in a row, against a smooth lone body
positive: typewriter keys, theater curtain folds, necklace chain, bolo tie, suspension bridge cables, vacuum brush, hammer rack, panpipe, chickadee on pebbles
negative: lean smooth single-bodied dogs and glass: Ibizan hound, dingo, goblet, bottle, dome

distinction: a dog head in side view with drooping ears (heat is on the ear), versus fluffy upright-eared or small pointed faces
positive: beagle, redbone, Appenzeller, kuvasz, Labrador, Weimaraner, bloodhound, Rhodesian ridgeback, Walker hound
negative: lesser panda, groenendael, Persian cat, papillon, house finch, Lhasa, Yorkshire terrier, keeshond: upright ears and fluffy rounded faces

distinction: a slender pointed head on a plain background
positive: borzoi, Saluki, whippet, juncos, ouzel, kite, oystercatcher
negative: unread

distinction: a small striped face of a cat, versus a heavy square-jawed dog face and radial things
positive: tabby, lynx, Egyptian cat, tiger cat, kit fox, tiger, leopard: striped fur around a round face
negative: Saint Bernard, bull mastiff, Rottweiler, American Staffordshire, indigo bunting, car wheel: heavy muzzles and radial

distinction: a bundle of fine bristle ends, parallel and uncovered
positive: shaving brush, thatch roof, beaver tail, paintbrush, digital 7-segment digits (parallel bars), porcupine
negative: pointed upright ears and smooth taut coats: dingo, basenji, toy terrier, German shepherd

distinction: a thin green or grey elongated body pressed along a branch or trunk
positive: green anole, chameleon, iguana, agama, leafhopper, frilled lizard
negative: radial-spoke objects: bolo tie, milk can, electric fan, car wheel, umbrella, rickshaw wheel; also wine glass

distinction: A small bird with a bright patch of colour on a slim body, against a shaggy, light, fluffy small dog.
positive: Bee-eater, indigo bunting, goldfinch, redshank, partridge, house finch, peacock, water ouzel, egret, macaw; heat on the coloured breast.
negative: Shaggy light small dogs: Norfolk terrier, Tibetan terrier, white wolf, malamute, West Highland, papillon, dingo, Greater Swiss; ambulance, caldron, jersey.

distinction: a soft-edged bright white plume rising from the ground or water against a darker or bluer backdrop
positive: geysers, fountains, fireboat spray, whale blow, waterfalls, breakwater splash, rocket exhaust
negative: round shiny rings and hubs (car wheel, carousel, pill bottle caps, ostrich head)

distinction: a vessel body with a loop handle on its side
positive: pitcher, cup, coffeepot, mug, teapot, cocktail shaker with cup (probe: handle 0.28, no handle 0.01)
negative: radial spokes and studs seen face-on: bolo tie, car wheel, umbrella, saltshaker, jinrikisha wheel

distinction: a dark solid compact body with a smooth outline, against a lighter lumpy background
positive: black dogs and bears, joystick, black kettle, hippo, siamang, abaya: dark mass with highlights
negative: tan, smooth-coated light-brown dogs (bull mastiff, boxer, Rhodesian)

distinction: a thin pointed thing sticking out toward or from a face or beak, small and bright against a blurred green ground
positive: child with a pink lolly, child eating ice lolly, spoonbill and stork beak, go-kart, apiary, grasshopper, leafhopper, damselfly: a small bright narrow thing in the middle of a soft background
negative: junco, green mamba, hair slide, screws, Siamese cat, coral reef: a sharp small object centred on a plain or very busy ground. Not clean

distinction: a horizontal band at the base of a scene: a waterline, floor or reflection line under an upright object
positive: boathouse on water, planetarium reflected, dock, egret, grocery aisle, mosque, obelisk, whistle; the heat is at the bottom edge
negative: dark standing dogs on grass: American Staffordshire, groenendael, keeshond, German shepherd, Great Pyrenees

distinction: thin straight rods or poles standing in a scene (a rack of wires, a pole, a horn)
positive: cat in dishwasher rack, French horn, sax, swab, mountain bikers, zebra, dalmatian, redshank, solar dish, damselfly, crane
negative: German shepherd on green, matchstick heart, beacon, kite, albatross, pinwheel, ladle: solid shapes or radial arrangements

distinction: a rusty orange-red patch on a soft small body, against a black dark mass
positive: proboscis monkey, ladybug, red fox, red-breasted merganser, brambling breast, Pomeranian, Rhodesian ridgeback, bagel
negative: black or very dark bodies: black cat, black dogs, wombat, hog, water buffalo, three-toed sloth, polecat; it keeps out black

distinction: A big smooth arc or box outline (a spray arc, a bridge arch, a van body) against shapes that radiate from a centre.
positive: Fireboat spray, ambulance, moving van, steel arch bridge, fountain, harp, minivan, pickup, limousine, tabby face, lemur.
negative: Radial or spiky things: umbrella (two kinds), sea urchin, washbasin, barn spider, black widow, plunger, stole, oystercatcher, pop bottles.

distinction: strands that curl, loop or link back on themselves, against sleek straight surface or radial legs
positive: chain links, knots, necklaces, curly or wavy hanging ears and coats (cocker, Sussex, Irish water spaniel, poodle), asparagus roll, coiled cornet
negative: short sleek coat and pointed radial shapes: Weimaraner, kelpie, pug, lipstick, starfish, tarantula, harvestman; it keeps out smooth or spiky

distinction: A compact, rounded, dark-or-saturated body seen against a plain ground, against a thin elongated shape.
positive: House finch, mink, beaver, hamster, marmot backs; yellow pickup and racer, school bus, ambulance front, digital watch, theater curtain, croquet ball. Heat on the rounded mass.
negative: Thin elongated things: ice-hockey puck, fountain pen, projectile, whistle, coho, bookcase; clothing (trench coat, paper towel).

distinction: A small perched bird with a bright warm or yellow breast against a dark or grey back and a bare, thin-branched background.
positive: House finch, goldfinch, indigo bunting, brambling, chickadee, junco; heat on the breast.
negative: Big dogs lying down (briard, German shepherd, bloodhound), car wheel, dome, bikini: large, round, or flat-lit.

distinction: open water surface with a body in it, against warm detailed objects on land
positive: submarine, whales, great white, coral reef, seashore, speedboat, snorkelers: blue-green water texture
negative: zebra, hourglass, rotisserie, phone box, langur: warm, tall, dry, fine detail

distinction: fine, high-contrast pattern on a small body (stripes, bars, bands, a mask) versus smooth plain surfaces
positive: black-footed ferret, indigo bunting, partridge, abacus, upright piano, tick, black widow, solar dish, custard apple: repeated thin bars or textured skin
negative: sleeping bag, scale, bath towel, whistle, mortar, sandal, safe: exactly the top photos of s4b1:255

distinction: a large bounded structure standing against sky
positive: castle, obelisk, dome, alp, container ship, aircraft carrier, barn, sports car
negative: people holding things, plunger, grocery store, cat

distinction: a banded or ridged side panel
positive: ostrich, bunting, jay, isopod, armadillo, freight car
negative: unread
